qoi: convergence order of the error on a fixed probe grid
equation: -div(sigma(u)) = f, with sigma(u) = 2*mu*eps(u) + lambda*tr(eps(u))*I and eps(u) = (grad(u) + grad(u)^T)/2
coefficients: Young's modulus E = 1000, Poisson ratio nu = 3/10, so lambda = 7500/13 and mu = 5000/13. Small strain, linear elastic.
bc_text: u = 0 (all three components) on the entire boundary of the cube
element: first-order (linear) tetrahedral or hexahedral displacement elements, small-displacement formulation
mesh_text: uniform meshes of the unit cube with N = 4, 8, 16 cells per side, all three levels
